newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Gazprom says Rodionov to join firm - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Gazprom says Rodionov to join firm - agency.

text.p: Former Russian Fuel and Energy Minister Pyotr Rodionov will be named deputy chairman of the board of gas monopoly Gazprom, Interfax news agency quoted Gazprom chairman Rem Vyakhirev as saying on Wednesday.
Rodionov said earlier on Wednesday that he would probably take up the post at RAO Gazprom. He said he was offered the job last week, and was now ready to accept it.
President Boris Yeltsin approved Rodionov's resignation on Tuesday. Vyakhirev said the position at Gazprom would be announced officially on Friday.
